title: Add animation-level semantic progress
summary: Exposed requested global progress and direction-normalized semantic progress on every equation stage, and moved gestalt realization from operation-local progress to the stable animation-level semantic clock.

sourceRefs.summary: Adds stage progress channels and prevents gestalt motion from resetting at every transformation boundary.
Covers forward and rewind semantic progress equivalence alongside local phase progress.
